findings.title: Plugin Request Completed log line loses traceID
findings.body: Before this change logRequest explicitly added "traceID" from tracing.TraceIDFromContext(ctx, false) plus pluginId/endpoint/dsName/dsUID/uname to logParams. The new code replaces those params with m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), and the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware only stores endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID and uname via log.WithContextualAttributes -- it never stores a trace ID. Unless the infra logger independently injects trace IDs (grafanaInfraLogWrapper.FromContext only adds stored contextual attributes), the 'Plugin Request Completed' line will no longer be correlatable by traceID, a regression for tracing/debugging plugin requests.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards the receiving logger's recorded state
findings.body: FromContext returns NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver or a logger sharing the receiver's Logs storage. LoggerMiddleware now logs via m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so any test that constructs a TestLogger, passes it to the middleware, and then asserts on that instance's InfoLogs.Calls/Message/Ctx will observe zero calls because the log was recorded on a throwaway instance. The fake should return f (or share its state) so FromContext logging remains observable in tests.

findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware and FromContext logging are untested
findings.body: This PR moves contextual-attribute enrichment out of MetricsMiddleware into the new ContextualLoggerMiddleware and makes LoggerMiddleware depend on it (and on middleware ordering in CreateMiddlewares) to retain endpoint/pluginId/dsName/dsUID/uname fields. No test is added for ContextualLoggerMiddleware, and no existing test verifies that a logger obtained via FromContext after this middleware emits those attributes or that LoggerMiddleware still emits them end-to-end. A middleware-ordering or context-key regression would therefore silently drop those fields without failing tests; the renamed metrics test even still declares TestInstrumentationMiddleware at metrics_middleware_test.go:21.
